name: Lila Thai Massage (Thapae)

tagline: Exceptional massages by ex-prisoners' rehabilitation graduates

description: Founded by former Women's Massage Center director Nom, Lila Thai Massage trains and employs women from the prison rehabilitation program. Professional technique, spotless rooms and honest prices have made it a Chiang Mai favourite across five branches.

nameZh: 更生女子按摩中心·清迈
taglineZh: 社会企业按摩馆的鼻祖
description: This pioneering center has helped hundreds of formerly incarcerated women rebuild their lives through professional massage training. The original branch near Tha Phae Gate offers honest, skilled traditional Thai massage in a modest, welcoming setting.
descriptionZh: 这一开创性中心通过专业按摩培训帮助数百名曾经服刑的女性重建生活。塔佩门附近的创始店环境朴素温馨，提供扎实地道、手法娴熟的泰式传统按摩。
